Phase-10.NAME: MyGraceGovernanceLint
Phase-10.purpose: Strengthen MyGRACE governance so managed source, dashboard, docs, and release files obey contract and markup rules.

steps.step-1: Define managed-file discovery rules from graph-index PATH entries and approved docs directories.
steps.step-2: Require MODULE_CONTRACT, MODULE_MAP, and CHANGE_SUMMARY in managed files where the role requires them.
steps.step-3: Change semantic block linting to pair START/END tags by exact block name.
steps.step-4: Add negative tests for missing maps, missing change summaries, orphan blocks, and dashboard/docs drift.
steps.step-5: Run MyGRACE lint, targeted MyGRACE tests, lint, and typecheck.
